artworks.title: Le lever
artworks.artist: Antoine Louis Romanet after Sigmund Freudenberger
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: This print shows three women in an opulently decorated room. In the center, a woman is reclining on a canopy bed, looking towards us with a slight smile, one hand raised to her face. She wears a dress with a low neckline, ornate sleeves, and a frilly bodice. On the left, a second woman kneels beside the bed, holding the other hand of the central woman. She is lifting a shoe up towards the woman on the bed, and there is another shoe on the ground next to her. The third woman is on the right, lifting the bed canopy. Both of these women wear bonnets and dresses. The room contains elegant furniture, including a chair and a small table, with patterned wallpaper and an ornate clock on the wall. Below the print are several lines of text.

artworks.title: Le bain
artworks.artist: Antoine Louis Romanet after Sigmund Freudenberger
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows two women and a dog in an elegant room. The seated woman is shown from the knees up on a luxurious chaise longue. She has delicate facial features with light hair tucked under a cap and wears a loose gown. She gestures with her left hand while her right arm rests. The standing woman is slightly bent forward, serving a hot beverage from a cup and saucer. She has styled up hair and wears a full-length gown with ruffled sleeves. Beside her, a small dog stands on a patterned floor, gazing up at her. In the background, there is an ornate canopy with heavy drapes and architectural details like an arch and decorative urn on a raised plinth on the walls.

artworks.title: La visite inattendue
artworks.artist: Nicolas Joseph Voyez after Sigmund Freudenberger
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts two elegantly dressed individuals, a man and a woman, inside a richly decorated interior. The man, on the right, has his right arm around the woman's shoulder. The woman, on the left, is holding a paper or scroll. She is wearing an ornate gown with elaborate detailing and an intricate hairstyle. The room has ornate wall decorations, a bed with a draped curtain, and a small dog nearby.

artworks.title: La Soirée d'hyver
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image portrays three figures, two women and one man, in an interior setting. The man is standing with one hand resting on his chest and the other at his side. He has long hair and is wearing a knee-length coat, breeches, and stockings. One woman is seated next to the man, facing him, wearing an elaborate gown with lace and ruffles. A small dog sits next to her. Another woman is reclined on a chair holding a fan. The background is elaborately decorated with a wall sconce, vases, and a clock on a mantel. A table lamp provides soft lighting.

artworks.title: Le coucher
artworks.medium: etching and (engraving?)
artworks.description: The image features three women in an elegant bedroom setting. The woman in the center faces the viewer with a calm expression, wearing a dress and a decorative head wrap. She is accompanied by another woman who leans slightly towards her. The third woman is seen near a large bed, arranging the bedding. The room is decorated with a high-backed chair, a framed portrait, a candelabra, and a fireplace. Various items are placed on the mantelpiece. The atmosphere suggests a serene moment in the evening.

The image shows a group of individuals in rich, colorful attire engaging in a formal dance in an open courtyard of a grand building. The participants are dressed in ornate costumes, including flowing gowns and outfits with feathered caps. A musician is shown at the side playing a drum and flute for the dancers. Two green columns frame the background where a small group appears seated on an elevated platform, likely representing figures of authority or onlookers of importance. The setting exudes a sense of celebration and pageantry characteristic of courtly life. The style is reminiscent of Jean Fouquet.
